title: Australia shark attack – level 2
paragraphs: A 35-year-old man died after a big shark attacked him in Western Australia. He was spearfishing with his family near a small island.

A giant Great White shark, about 4.5 meters long, bit him badly. His family tried to save him and took him on a fast boat to the town of Albany, but his injuries were too bad, and he died on the way. People in the town are very sad because it is a small place where everyone knows each other. Hours before, a special satellite machine saw a big shark near the beach. An expert said this is the fourth bad shark attack in Australia this year. He explained that fishing underwater is very dangerous because sharks can smell the blood of the fish. He tells people to stay out of dark water and away from groups of small fish.

words.d: catching fish underwater with a long sharp stick
to notice something using your nose
